title: How do I look up my Transaction ID or Address on the Blockchain?

body: To see your transaction in a block explorer, tap on the transaction in your wallet history, scroll, and then tap "Show in Explorer". This will bring up the transaction ID and a link to view it on a block explorer. You can also copy the transactions ID and enter it into your favorite block explorer.
